title: No Fish Drops
description: Disables item drops from fish mobs.
body:
No Fish Drops is a simple Minecraft data pack that disables item drops from fish mobs.

## Features

- Cod no longer drops items
- Salmon no longer drops items
- Pufferfish no longer drops items
- Tropical fish no longer drops items
- Server-side only
- No mods required

## Installation

1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Put it into your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload`.
4. Check `/datapack list`.

## Notes

This data pack changes vanilla fish entity loot tables.
